# DeepSeek API Docs

> Unofficial markdown mirror of https://api-docs.deepseek.com/ -- the
> DeepSeek API documentation (OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible chat, reasoning,
> tool calls, pricing, agent integrations). English pages listed below;
> a Chinese mirror lives in content/zh-cn/ with identical paths.
> The dsh section mirrors github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness and
> npm (@deepseek-ai/dsh), not api-docs -- see scripts/dsh.py.

Each file carries frontmatter with its canonical `source:` URL.

## Getting Started

- [Your First API Call](content/en/index.md): The DeepSeek API uses an API format compatible with OpenAI/Anthropic. By modifying the configuration, you can use the OpenAI/Anthropic SDK or softwares com...
- [Error Codes](content/en/quick_start/error_codes.md): When calling DeepSeek API, you may encounter errors. Here list the causes and solutions.
- [Models & Pricing](content/en/quick_start/pricing.md): The prices listed below are in units of per 1M tokens. A token, the smallest unit of text that the model recognizes, can be a word, a number, or even a pun...
- [Rate Limit & Isolation](content/en/quick_start/rate_limit.md): Concurrency Limit
- [Token & Token Usage](content/en/quick_start/token_usage.md): Tokens are the basic units used by models to represent natural language text, and also the units we use for billing. They can be intuitively understood as ...

## API Reference

- [Chat Completions API](content/en/api/create-chat-completion.md): Creates a model response for the given chat conversation.
- [FIM Completion API (Beta)](content/en/api/create-completion.md): FIM (Fill In the Middle) Completion API.<br/>User must set `base_url='https://api.deepseek.com/beta'` to use this feature.
- [Upload File](content/en/api/create-file.md): Upload an image file that can later be referenced by its `file_id` in chat completion requests.
- [Responses API](content/en/api/create-response.md): Creates a model response in the OpenAI Responses API format.
- [DeepSeek API](content/en/api/deepseek-api.md): The DeepSeek API. To use the DeepSeek API, please [create an API key first](https://platform.deepseek.com/api_keys).
- [Delete File](content/en/api/delete-file.md): Deletes a file.
- [Get User Balance](content/en/api/get-user-balance.md): Get user current balance
- [List Files](content/en/api/list-files.md): Returns a list of files that belong to the user, with cursor-based pagination.
- [Lists Models](content/en/api/list-models.md): Lists the currently available models, and provides basic information about each one such as the owner and availability. Check [Models & Pricing](/quick_sta...
- [Retrieve File](content/en/api/retrieve-file.md): Returns information about a specific file.

## Guides

- [Using the Anthropic API](content/en/guides/anthropic_api.md): To meet the demand for using the Anthropic API ecosystem, our API has added support for the Anthropic API format, with the base_url being https://api.deeps...
- [Chat Prefix Completion (Beta)](content/en/guides/chat_prefix_completion.md): The chat prefix completion follows the Chat Completion API, where users provide an assistant's prefix message for the model to complete the rest of the mes...
- [Integrate with AI Tools](content/en/guides/coding_agents.md): This guide shows how to integrate DeepSeek models with popular AI coding tools, including Claude Code, OpenCode, and OpenClaw.
- [Files API](content/en/guides/files_api.md): The Files API lets you upload images and reference them later by file_id. It is the recommended way to:
- [FIM Completion (Beta)](content/en/guides/fim_completion.md): In FIM (Fill In the Middle) completion, users can provide a prefix and a suffix (optional), and the model will complete the content in between. FIM is comm...
- [JSON Output](content/en/guides/json_mode.md): In many scenarios, users need the model to output in strict JSON format to achieve structured output, facilitating subsequent parsing.
- [Context Caching](content/en/guides/kv_cache.md): The DeepSeek API Context Caching on Disk Technology is enabled by default for all users, allowing them to benefit without needing to modify their code.
- [Multi-round Conversation](content/en/guides/multi_round_chat.md): This guide will introduce how to use the DeepSeek /chat/completions API for multi-turn conversations.
- [Using the Responses API](content/en/guides/responses_api.md): To meet the demand for Codex, our API now supports the Responses API format, with the base_url being https://api.deepseek.com.
- [Thinking Mode](content/en/guides/thinking_mode.md): The DeepSeek model supports the thinking mode: before outputting the final answer, the model will first output a chain-of-thought reasoning to improve the ...
- [Tool Calls](content/en/guides/tool_calls.md): Tool Calls allows the model to call external tools to enhance its capabilities.
- [Vision](content/en/guides/vision.md): The deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp model accepts images alongside text, so you can ask the model to describe pictures, read text from screenshots, analyze ch...

## Agent Integrations

- [Integrate with AstrBot](content/en/quick_start/agent_integrations/astrbot.md): AstrBot is an open-source all-in-one agent assistant that integrates with mainstream messaging platforms such as QQ, WeChat, Feishu, and Telegram, and can ...
- [Integrate with Claude Code](content/en/quick_start/agent_integrations/claude_code.md): Claude Code is an AI coding assistant that runs in the terminal.
- [Integrate with Codex](content/en/quick_start/agent_integrations/codex.md): Codex is an AI coding assistant from OpenAI. It talks to models via the Responses API, which the DeepSeek API natively supports.
- [Integrate with GitHub Copilot CLI](content/en/quick_start/agent_integrations/copilot_cli.md): Configure GitHub Copilot CLI to use DeepSeek V4 models via BYOK (Bring Your Own Key) with the Anthropic-compatible endpoint.
- [Integrate with Crush](content/en/quick_start/agent_integrations/crush.md): Crush is a glamorous open-source AI coding agent that runs in your terminal, built by Charm. It supports multi-model switching, LSP integration, MCP server...
- [Integrate with Deep Code](content/en/quick_start/agent_integrations/deepcode.md): Deep Code is an open-source terminal AI coding assistant for the DeepSeek-V4 model, supporting deep thinking, reasoning effort control, and Agent Skills.
- [Integrate with GitHub Copilot](content/en/quick_start/agent_integrations/github_copilot.md): DeepSeek V4 for Copilot Chat is a VS Code extension that adds DeepSeek V4 Pro & Flash directly into the GitHub Copilot Chat model picker. You keep Copilot'...
- [Integrate with Hermes Agent](content/en/quick_start/agent_integrations/hermes.md): Hermes is an open-source AI agent built by Nous Research.
- [Integrate with Kilo Code](content/en/quick_start/agent_integrations/kilo_code.md): Kilo Code is an AI coding assistant available as a CLI and editor extension.
- [Integrate with Langcli](content/en/quick_start/agent_integrations/langcli.md): Langcli is an AI coding assistant that supports CLI and Zed ACP Agent.
- [Integrating nanobot](content/en/quick_start/agent_integrations/nanobot.md): nanobot is a lightweight AI agent that supports integration with popular chat tools.
- [Using DeepSeek with Oh My Pi](content/en/quick_start/agent_integrations/oh_my_pi.md): Oh My Pi is a terminal AI coding agent. As of v14.5 it ships DeepSeek V4 model entries, but the built-in compat is incomplete — a custom models.yml is stil...
- [Integrate with OpenClaw](content/en/quick_start/agent_integrations/openclaw.md): OpenClaw is an open-source personal AI assistant that can connect to popular chat tools like Feishu and WeChat, and can be extended through Skills.
- [Integrate with OpenCode](content/en/quick_start/agent_integrations/opencode.md): OpenCode is an open-source AI coding assistant available in terminal, web, and other forms.
- [Integrate with Pi](content/en/quick_start/agent_integrations/pi_mono.md): Pi (pi-mono) is a minimal, aggressively extensible terminal coding harness. It adapts to your workflows through TypeScript extensions, skills, prompt templ...
- [Integrate with Reasonix](content/en/quick_start/agent_integrations/reasonix.md): Reasonix is a coding agent that runs in the terminal.
- [Integrate with WorkBuddy/CodeBuddy](content/en/quick_start/agent_integrations/workbuddy.md): WorkBuddy/CodeBuddy is an AI agent and coding assistant. It supports custom models through local model configuration files, and DeepSeek V4 can be connecte...
